from solution import Service, GatewayTimeout


class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class Gateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.charges = {}
        self.timeouts = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        if self.timeouts > 0:
            self.timeouts -= 1
            # outcome unknown: charge may have happened
            self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        self.charges.setdefault(reference, amount_cents)


def make(user="alice", ttl=3600):
    clock, gw = Clock(), Gateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    assert svc.register(user, "password1")[0] == 201
    status, body = svc.login(user, "password1")
    assert status == 200
    return svc, clock, gw, body["token"]


def second_user(svc, name="bob"):
    assert svc.register(name, "password1")[0] == 201
    return svc.login(name, "password1")[1]["token"]


def test_register_validation():
    svc = Service(Clock(), Gateway())
    assert svc.register("ab", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 33, "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("Alice", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("al ice", "password1")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("alice", "short")[0] == 400
    assert svc.register("a" * 32, "12345678")[0] == 201
    assert svc.register("a" * 32, "12345678")[0] == 409


def test_token_expiry_boundary():
    svc, clock, _, token = make(ttl=100)
    clock.t = 1099.9
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 200
    clock.t = 1100.0
    assert svc.export_documents(token)[0] == 401


def test_logout():
    svc, _, _, t1 = make()
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert t1 != t2
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t1)[0] == 401
    assert svc.export_documents(t2)[0] == 200


def test_document_validation_and_unique_ids():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    assert svc.create_document(t, "", "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 201, "x")[0] == 400
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a" * 200, "x" * 100000)[0] == 201
    assert svc.create_document(t, "a", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400
    a = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    svc.delete_document(t, a)
    b = svc.create_document(t, "a", "")[1]["id"]
    assert a != b


def test_ownership():
    svc, _, _, ta = make()
    tb = second_user(svc)
    doc_id = svc.create_document(ta, "secret", "stuff")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.get_document(tb, doc_id)[0] == 404
    assert svc.get_document(tb, "nope")[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(tb, doc_id, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(tb, doc_id)[0] == 404
    assert svc.list_documents(tb)[1]["items"] == []
    assert svc.search_documents(tb, "secret")[1] == []
    assert svc.export_documents(tb)[1] == []
    assert svc.get_document(ta, doc_id)[0] == 200


def test_delete_then_everything_404():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    d = svc.create_document(t, "a", "b")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.delete_document(t, d)[0] == 204
    assert svc.get_document(t, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.update_document(t, d, "x", "y")[0] == 404
    assert svc.delete_document(t, d)[0] == 404
    assert svc.export_documents(t)[1] == []


def test_pagination():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    ids = [svc.create_document(t, "t%d" % i, "")[1]["id"] for i in range(5)]
    st, p1 = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2)
    assert [d["id"] for d in p1["items"]] == ids[:2]
    assert p1["next_cursor"] is not None
    # delete one before and one after cursor, add new one
    svc.delete_document(t, ids[1])
    svc.delete_document(t, ids[2])
    new = svc.create_document(t, "new", "")[1]["id"]
    st, p2 = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2, cursor=p1["next_cursor"])
    assert [d["id"] for d in p2["items"]] == [ids[3], ids[4]]
    st, p3 = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=2, cursor=p2["next_cursor"])
    assert [d["id"] for d in p3["items"]] == [new]
    assert p3["next_cursor"] is None


def test_exact_page_has_no_cursor():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    for i in range(4):
        svc.create_document(t, "t", "")
    st, p = svc.list_documents(t, page_size=4)
    assert len(p["items"]) == 4 and p["next_cursor"] is None


def test_pagination_bad_input():
    svc, _, _, ta = make()
    tb = second_user(svc)
    for i in range(3):
        svc.create_document(ta, "t", "")
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, page_size=0)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, page_size=101)[0] == 400
    assert svc.list_documents(ta, cursor="bogus")[0] == 400
    cur = svc.list_documents(ta, page_size=1)[1]["next_cursor"]
    assert svc.list_documents(tb, cursor=cur)[0] == 400


def test_search_and_update_keeps_order():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    a = svc.create_document(t, "Alpha", "one")[1]["id"]
    b = svc.create_document(t, "Beta", "ALPHA inside")[1]["id"]
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.search_documents(t, "alpha")[1]] == [a, b]
    assert svc.search_documents(t, "")[0] == 400
    svc.update_document(t, a, "Alpha2", "z")
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.export_documents(t)[1]] == [a, b]
    assert [d["id"] for d in svc.list_documents(t)[1]["items"]] == [a, b]


def test_update_validation():
    svc, _, _, t = make()
    a = svc.create_document(t, "A", "")[1]["id"]
    assert svc.update_document(t, a, "", "")[0] == 400
    assert svc.update_document(t, a, "A", "x" * 100001)[0] == 400


def test_payment_validation():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    assert svc.pay(t, 0, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1000001, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1.5, "k")[0] == 400
    assert svc.pay(t, 1, "k")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(t, 1000000, "k2")[0] == 201


def test_idempotency():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    st, p = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert st == 201
    st2, p2 = svc.pay(t, 100, "k")
    assert st2 == 200 and p2["id"] == p["id"]
    assert svc.pay(t, 200, "k")[0] == 409
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1


def test_idempotency_scoped_per_user():
    svc, _, gw, ta = make()
    tb = second_user(svc)
    assert svc.pay(ta, 100, "k")[0] == 201
    assert svc.pay(tb, 300, "k")[0] == 201
    assert len(gw.charges) == 2
    assert len(svc.list_payments(tb)[1]) == 1


def test_timeout_then_retry():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    gw.timeouts = 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.list_payments(t)[1] == []
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] in (200, 201)
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 200
    assert len(svc.list_payments(t)[1]) == 1
    assert len(gw.charges) == 1


def test_timeout_then_different_amount():
    svc, _, gw, t = make()
    gw.timeouts = 1
    assert svc.pay(t, 100, "k")[0] == 504
    assert svc.pay(t, 200, "k")[0] == 409


def test_invalid_tokens_everywhere():
    svc, _, _, _ = make()
    for tok in (None, "x", 5):
        assert svc.get_document(tok, "d")[0] == 401
        assert svc.pay(tok, 1, "k")[0] == 401
        assert svc.list_payments(tok)[0] == 401
        assert svc.list_documents(tok)[0] == 401
        assert svc.search_documents(tok, "a")[0] == 401
        assert svc.create_document(tok, "a", "")[0] == 401
        assert svc.logout(tok)[0] == 401

import string

import pytest
from hypothesis import given, settings, strategies as st

from solution import Service
from gateway import GatewayTimeout


# ----------------------------------------------------------------- fakes

class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class FakeGateway:
    """Idempotent by reference; can time out before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}  # reference -> amount (effective charges)
        self.mode = "ok"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        if self.mode == "timeout_before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "timeout_after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}


def make(ttl=None):
    clock = FakeClock()
    gw = FakeGateway()
    svc = Service(clock, gw) if ttl is None else Service(clock, gw, token_ttl=ttl)
    return svc, clock, gw


def signup(svc, name="alice", password="password1"):
    r = svc.register(name, password)
    assert r[0] == 201, f"input={(name, password)!r} output={r!r}"
    s, b = svc.login(name, password)
    assert s == 200, f"input={(name, password)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    return b["token"]


def mk(svc, tok, title="t", content="c"):
    s, b = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert s == 201, f"input={(title, content)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    assert isinstance(b["id"], str), f"input={(title, content)!r} output={b!r}"
    return b["id"]


DOC_KEYS = {"id", "owner", "title", "content", "created_at"}
PAY_KEYS = {"id", "amount_cents", "idempotency_key", "created_at"}

ALL_CALLS = ["logout", "create", "get", "update", "delete", "list",
             "search", "export", "pay", "payments"]


def call(svc, name, tok, doc_id="x"):
    if name == "logout":
        return svc.logout(tok)
    if name == "create":
        return svc.create_document(tok, "new", "body")
    if name == "get":
        return svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)
    if name == "update":
        return svc.update_document(tok, doc_id, "upd", "upd")
    if name == "delete":
        return svc.delete_document(tok, doc_id)
    if name == "list":
        return svc.list_documents(tok)
    if name == "search":
        return svc.search_documents(tok, "o")
    if name == "export":
        return svc.export_documents(tok)
    if name == "pay":
        return svc.pay(tok, 100, "key-1")
    if name == "payments":
        return svc.list_payments(tok)
    raise AssertionError(name)


def assert_untouched(svc, tok, doc_id, gw):
    s, b = svc.export_documents(tok)
    assert s == 200, f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    assert [d["id"] for d in b] == [doc_id], f"output={b!r}"
    assert b[0]["title"] == "orig" and b[0]["content"] == "orig-content", f"output={b!r}"
    s, b = svc.list_payments(tok)
    assert (s, b) == (200, []), f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    assert gw.charged == {}, f"charged={gw.charged!r}"


def setup_with_doc(ttl=None):
    svc, clock, gw = make(ttl)
    tok = signup(svc)
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok, "orig", "orig-content")
    return svc, clock, gw, tok, doc_id


# ------------------------------------------------------------ REQ-14 auth

VALID_USER_CHARS = string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + "_"


def valid_username(s):
    return 3 <= len(s) <= 32 and all(c in VALID_USER_CHARS for c in s)


def test_register_success_and_duplicate():
    """A valid registration returns 201 and a repeated username returns 409."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    r1 = svc.register("alice_1", "password1")
    r2 = svc.register("alice_1", "otherpassword")
    assert r1[0] == 201, f"output={r1!r}"
    assert r2[0] == 409, f"output={r2!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name,expected", [
    ("abc", 201), ("a" * 32, 201), ("ab", 400), ("a" * 33, 400),
    ("", 400), ("Abc", 400), ("ab-c", 400), ("ab c", 400), ("abc\n", 400),
    ("abcé", 400), ("a_1", 201),
])
def test_username_boundaries(name, expected):
    """A username must be 3 to 32 characters from [a-z0-9_], otherwise register returns 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    r = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert r[0] == expected, f"input={name!r} output={r!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pw,expected", [
    ("12345678", 201), ("1234567", 400), ("", 400), ("x" * 100, 201),
])
def test_password_boundaries(pw, expected):
    """A password must have at least 8 characters, otherwise register returns 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    r = svc.register("bob", pw)
    assert r[0] == expected, f"input={pw!r} output={r!r}"


@settings(max_examples=80, deadline=None)
@given(st.text(max_size=40).filter(lambda s: not valid_username(s)))
def test_invalid_usernames_rejected(name):
    """A username outside 3-32 characters of [a-z0-9_] must be rejected with 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    r = svc.register(name, "password1")
    assert r[0] == 400, f"input={name!r} output={r!r}"


@settings(max_examples=80, deadline=None)
@given(st.text(alphabet=VALID_USER_CHARS, min_size=3, max_size=32),
       st.text(min_size=8, max_size=40))
def test_valid_credentials_register_and_login(name, pw):
    """A valid username and password register with 201 and can log in with 200 and a token."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    r = svc.register(name, pw)
    assert r[0] == 201, f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={r!r}"
    s, b = svc.login(name, pw)
    assert s == 200 and isinstance(b["token"], str), f"input={(name, pw)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    bad = svc.login(name, pw + "x")
    assert bad[0] == 401, f"input={(name, pw + 'x')!r} output={bad!r}"


@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
@given(st.text(min_size=8, max_size=20))
def test_short_passwords_rejected(pw_tail):
    """A password shorter than 8 characters must be rejected with 400."""
    pw = pw_tail[:7]
    svc, _, _ = make()
    r = svc.register("carol", pw)
    assert r[0] == 400, f"input={pw!r} output={r!r}"


def test_login_failures_return_401():
    """Login with a wrong password or an unknown user must return 401."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    svc.register("alice", "password1")
    r1 = svc.login("alice", "wrongpass1")
    r2 = svc.login("nobody", "password1")
    assert r1[0] == 401, f"output={r1!r}"
    assert r2[0] == 401, f"output={r2!r}"


def test_login_returns_distinct_valid_tokens():
    """Each login returns a new token and both tokens are valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    t1 = signup(svc)
    s, b = svc.login("alice", "password1")
    t2 = b["token"]
    assert t1 != t2, f"tokens={t1!r},{t2!r}"
    for t in (t1, t2):
        r = svc.list_documents(t)
        assert r[0] == 200, f"input={t!r} output={r!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", [None, "", "unknown-token"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ALL_CALLS)
def test_missing_or_unknown_token_is_401(name, bad):
    """Every token method must return 401 for a missing or unknown token and change nothing."""
    svc, _, gw, tok, doc_id = setup_with_doc()
    r = call(svc, name, bad, doc_id)
    assert r[0] == 401, f"method={name} token={bad!r} output={r!r}"
    assert_untouched(svc, tok, doc_id, gw)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ALL_CALLS)
def test_token_valid_just_before_expiry(name):
    """A token must be accepted while clock.now() < created + token_ttl."""
    svc, clock, gw, tok, doc_id = setup_with_doc(ttl=100)
    clock.t = 1099.5
    r = call(svc, name, tok, doc_id)
    assert r[0] != 401, f"method={name} now={clock.t} output={r!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ALL_CALLS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("now", [1100.0, 1100.5, 9000.0])
def test_token_rejected_from_expiry_instant(name, now):
    """A token must be rejected with 401 from the instant created + token_ttl."""
    svc, clock, gw, tok, doc_id = setup_with_doc(ttl=100)
    clock.t = now
    r = call(svc, name, tok, doc_id)
    assert r[0] == 401, f"method={name} now={now} output={r!r}"
    s, b = svc.login("alice", "password1")
    assert s == 200, f"output={(s, b)!r}"
    assert_untouched(svc, b["token"], doc_id, gw)


def test_default_ttl_is_3600():
    """With the default token_ttl, a token is valid until 3600 seconds after creation."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc)
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3599.0
    r1 = svc.list_documents(tok)
    clock.t = 1000.0 + 3600.0
    r2 = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert r1[0] == 200, f"output={r1!r}"
    assert r2[0] == 401, f"output={r2!r}"


def test_expiry_counts_from_creation_not_last_use():
    """A token's validity runs for token_ttl seconds after creation regardless of use."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=100)
    tok = signup(svc)
    clock.t = 1060.0
    r1 = svc.list_documents(tok)
    clock.t = 1100.0
    r2 = svc.list_documents(tok)
    assert r1[0] == 200, f"output={r1!r}"
    assert r2[0] == 401, f"output={r2!r}"


def test_each_token_expires_relative_to_its_own_creation():
    """Each token expires token_ttl seconds after its own creation."""
    svc, clock, _ = make(ttl=100)
    t1 = signup(svc)
    clock.t = 1050.0
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    clock.t = 1100.0
    r1 = svc.list_documents(t1)
    r2 = svc.list_documents(t2)
    assert r1[0] == 401, f"output={r1!r}"
    assert r2[0] == 200, f"output={r2!r}"


# ------------------------------------------------------------ REQ-15 logout

def test_logout_revokes_only_that_token():
    """Logout revokes the given token while other tokens of the same user stay valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    t1 = signup(svc)
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    doc_id = mk(svc, t1, "a", "b")
    r = svc.logout(t1)
    assert r[0] == 204, f"output={r!r}"
    r2 = svc.get_document(t2, doc_id)
    assert r2[0] == 200 and r2[1]["id"] == doc_id, f"output={r2!r}"
    assert svc.list_documents(t2)[0] == 200


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ALL_CALLS)
def test_revoked_token_rejected_by_every_method(name):
    """A revoked token must be rejected with 401 by every method and change nothing."""
    svc, _, gw, t1, doc_id = setup_with_doc()
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    r = call(svc, name, t1, doc_id)
    assert r[0] == 401, f"method={name} output={r!r}"
    assert_untouched(svc, t2, doc_id, gw)


def test_logout_twice_and_unknown():
    """Logging out an already revoked or unknown token must return 401."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    t1 = signup(svc)
    assert svc.logout(t1)[0] == 204
    r = svc.logout(t1)
    r2 = svc.logout("nope")
    assert r[0] == 401, f"output={r!r}"
    assert r2[0] == 401, f"output={r2!r}"


def test_login_after_logout_gives_working_token():
    """A user can log in again after logging out and the new token is valid."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    t1 = signup(svc)
    svc.logout(t1)
    t2 = svc.login("alice", "password1")[1]["token"]
    r = svc.list_documents(t2)
    assert r[0] == 200, f"output={r!r}"


def test_logout_does_not_affect_other_users():
    """Revoking a token of one user must not affect another user's token."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    ta = signup(svc, "alice")
    tb = signup(svc, "bobby")
    svc.logout(ta)
    r = svc.list_documents(tb)
    assert r[0] == 200, f"output={r!r}"


# --------------------------------------------------- REQ-16 creation

def test_create_returns_id_and_get_returns_document():
    """create_document returns 201 with an id and the stored document has the specified fields."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc)
    clock.t = 1234.5
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok, "Title", "Content")
    s, d = svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)
    assert s == 200, f"output={(s, d)!r}"
    assert set(d) == DOC_KEYS, f"output={d!r}"
    assert d["id"] == doc_id and d["title"] == "Title" and d["content"] == "Content", f"output={d!r}"
    assert d["created_at"] == 1234.5, f"output={d!r}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("title,content,expected", [
    ("a", "", 201), ("a" * 200, "x", 201), ("", "x", 400), ("a" * 201, "x", 400),
    ("t", "c" * 100000, 201), ("t", "c" * 100001, 400),
])
def test_create_validation_boundaries(title, content, expected):
    """A title of 1-200 characters and content of at most 100,000 characters are required, otherwise 400."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc)
    s, b = svc.create_document(tok, title, content)
    assert s == expected, f"input={(len(title), len(content))!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
    s2, b2 = svc.export_documents(tok)
    assert len(b2) == (1 if expected == 201 else 0), f"input={(len(title), len(content))!r} output={b2!r}"


@settings(max_examples=60, deadline=None)
@given(st.text(min_size=1, max_size=200), st.text(max_size=300))
def test_valid_create_roundtrip(title, content):
    """A document with a valid title and content is stored and returned unchanged."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc)
    doc_id = mk(svc, tok, title, content)
    s, d = svc.get_document(tok, doc_id)
    assert s == 200 and d["title"] == title and d["content"] == content, \

@settings(max_examples=50, deadline=None)

@given(st.integers(1, 5), st.integers(0, 12),
       st.lists(st.lists(st.tuples(st.booleans(), st.integers(0, 1000)), max_size=3), max_size=8))
def test_pagination_under_concurrent_creates_and_deletes(ps, n, ops_per_page):
    """Documents deleted after a cursor are not returned, later ones appear, none repeat or are skipped."""
    svc, _, _ = make()
    tok = signup(svc)
    order = []
    alive = set()
    for i in range(n):
        d = mk(svc, tok, f"t{i}")
        order.append(d)
        alive.add(d)
    returned = []
    cursor = None
    step = 0
    last_alive = None
    for _ in range(200):
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok, ps, cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"input={(ps, cursor)!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
        ids = [d["id"] for d in b["items"]]
        assert len(ids) <= ps, f"input={ps!r} output={ids!r}"
        for i in ids:
            assert i in alive, f"returned non-live doc id={i!r} alive={sorted(alive)!r}"
        returned.extend(ids)
        if b["next_cursor"] is None:
            last_alive = set(alive)
            break
        cursor = b["next_cursor"]
        ops = ops_per_page[step] if step < len(ops_per_page) else []
        step += 1
        for is_create, k in ops:
            if is_create:
                d = mk(svc, tok, f"n{len(order)}")
                order.append(d)
                alive.add(d)
            elif alive:
                victims = sorted(alive, key=order.index)
                v = victims[k % len(victims)]
                r = svc.delete_document(tok, v)
                assert r[0] == 204, f"input={v!r} output={r!r}"
                alive.discard(v)
    else:
        pytest.fail("cursor chain did not terminate")
    assert len(set(returned)) == len(returned), f"duplicates in {returned!r}"
    idx = [order.index(i) for i in returned]
    assert idx == sorted(idx), f"not in creation order: {returned!r}"
    missing = last_alive - set(returned)
    assert not missing, f"skipped live documents {sorted(missing)!r} returned={returned!r}"

class Clock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; can time out before/after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = []
        self.fail_next = None

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        mode, self.fail_next = self.fail_next, None
        if mode == "before":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if mode == "after":
            raise GatewayTimeout()
        return True

       st.lists(st.tuples(st.integers(0, 2), st.integers(0, 1000)), max_size=40))
@SETTINGS
def test_property_pagination_matches_model_under_mutation(n, ps, muts):
    """Following cursors returns each remaining document exactly once, oldest first, despite interleaved deletes and creates."""
    svc, _, _, (tok,) = make()
    live = []  # ids in creation order
    created = []
    for i in range(n):
        d = mk(svc, tok, "d%d" % i)
        live.append(d)
        created.append(d)
    last_pos = -1  # index in `created` of last returned doc
    cursor = None
    returned = []
    step = 0
    while True:
        s, b = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=ps, cursor=cursor)
        assert s == 200, f"n={n} ps={ps} muts={muts!r} output={(s, b)!r}"
        remaining = [d for d in live if created.index(d) > last_pos]
        exp = remaining[:ps]
        got = [d["id"] for d in b["items"]]
        assert got == exp, f"n={n} ps={ps} muts={muts!r} got={got!r} exp={exp!r}"
        returned += got
        if got:
            last_pos = created.index(got[-1])
        more = len(remaining) > ps
        assert (b["next_cursor"] is not None) == more, f"n={n} ps={ps} muts={muts!r} output={b!r}"
        if not more:
            break
        cursor = b["next_cursor"]
        if step < len(muts):
            kind, r = muts[step]
            if kind == 1 and live:
                victim = live.pop(r % len(live))
                assert svc.delete_document(tok, victim)[0] == 204
            elif kind == 2:
                d = mk(svc, tok, "new%d" % step)
                live.append(d)
                created.append(d)
        step += 1
    assert len(set(returned)) == len(returned), f"duplicates returned={returned!r}"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------- fakes

def _timeout():
    try:
        return GatewayTimeout()
    except TypeError:
        return GatewayTimeout("timeout")


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, t=1000.0):
        self.t = t

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, dt):
        self.t += dt


class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; can time out before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}  # reference -> amount
        self.calls = 0
        self.mode = "ok"  # ok | timeout_before | timeout_after

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.mode == "timeout_before":
            raise _timeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "timeout_after":
            raise _timeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

def follow(svc, tok, page_size, cursor=None, first=None):
    """Collect ids by following cursors; returns ids in order of appearance."""

@settings(max_examples=80, deadline=None)
@given(
    n=st.integers(0, 8),
    page_size=st.integers(1, 4),
    script=st.lists(
        st.lists(st.tuples(st.sampled_from(["create", "delete", "update"]), st.integers(0, 20)), max_size=3),
        max_size=8,
    ),
)
def test_prop_pagination_under_concurrent_modification(n, page_size, script):
    """While paging, deleted documents are not returned, nothing is repeated or skipped, order is by creation, and new documents appear."""
    svc, clock, _ = make()
    tok = user(svc)
    order, alive = [], set()

    def create():
        i = new_doc(svc, tok, f"t{len(order)}")
        order.append(i)
        alive.add(i)

    for _ in range(n):
        create()
    ctx = f"input={(n, page_size, script)!r}"
    returned = []
    out = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=page_size)
    page = 0
    while True:
        assert out[0] == 200, f"{ctx} output={out!r}"
        page_ids = ids(out[1]["items"])
        assert len(page_ids) <= page_size, f"{ctx} output={out!r}"
        for i in page_ids:
            assert i in alive, f"{ctx} returned dead/unknown id {i!r}; output={out!r}"
            assert i not in returned, f"{ctx} repeated id {i!r}; returned={returned!r}"
            if returned:
                assert order.index(i) > order.index(returned[-1]), \
                    f"{ctx} order violated at {i!r}; returned={returned!r}"
            returned.append(i)
        cursor = out[1]["next_cursor"]
        if cursor is None:
            break
        if page < len(script):
            for kind, k in script[page]:
                live = [i for i in order if i in alive]
                if kind == "create":
                    create()
                elif live:
                    target = live[k % len(live)]
                    if kind == "delete":
                        assert svc.delete_document(tok, target)[0] == 204, ctx
                        alive.discard(target)
                    else:
                        clock.advance(1)
                        assert svc.update_document(tok, target, "upd", "upd")[0] == 200, ctx
        page += 1
        assert page < 100, f"{ctx} pagination did not terminate"
        out = svc.list_documents(tok, page_size=page_size, cursor=cursor)
    skipped = [i for i in order if i in alive and i not in returned]
    assert skipped == [], f"{ctx} skipped={skipped!r} returned={returned!r}"

def _timeout():

class FakeGateway:
    """Charges at most once per reference; can time out before or after charging."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.charged = {}
        self.calls = 0
        self.mode = "ok"

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls += 1
        if self.mode == "timeout_before":
            raise _timeout()
        if reference not in self.charged:
            self.charged[reference] = amount_cents
        if self.mode == "timeout_after":
            raise _timeout()
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

"""
Specification guarantees covered by these tests:

- Registration accepts only usernames of 3 to 32 characters from [a-z0-9_]
  and passwords of at least 8 characters; invalid input returns 400 and an
  existing username returns 409.
- Login with correct credentials returns a fresh token; incorrect credentials
  return 401.
- Tokens are accepted only before created + token_ttl, expire exactly at that
  boundary, and logout revokes only the given token.
- Every token-taking method rejects missing, unknown, expired, or revoked
  tokens with 401.
- Document creation validates title and content bounds, assigns unique
  lifetime IDs, records owner and creation time, and stores only caller-owned
  documents.
- Users cannot observe, update, delete, list, search, or export another user's
  documents; access to another user's document is indistinguishable from a
  missing document with 404 where applicable.
- Updating validates document fields, preserves creation ordering and creation
  time, and deletion makes the document disappear permanently.
- Listing returns caller-owned documents in creation order, enforces page size
  1..100, rejects cursors not issued to the caller, and cursors do not skip or
  duplicate remaining documents when documents are deleted or created after a
  cursor is issued.
- Search rejects empty queries and returns caller-owned matching documents in
  creation order, matching title or content case-insensitively.
- Export returns all caller-owned documents in creation order.
- Payments validate amount bounds, charge through the gateway, record caller
  payments in creation order, scope idempotency keys to the caller, return the
  original payment for same-key same-amount retries, reject same-key
  different-amount retries with 409, and record no payment on gateway timeout.
- Payment retry after a timeout with the same key and amount completes at most
  one recorded payment and at most one gateway charge.

OPEN QUESTIONS:
- Error response bodies are unspecified.
- Bodies for 204 responses are unspecified.
- Concrete formats of generated document IDs, payment IDs, tokens, cursors, and
  gateway references are unspecified.
- The gateway return value is unspecified.
- Behavior for argument types outside the described domains, other than payment

    def __init__(self, start=0.0):
        self.t = float(start)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, seconds):
        self.t += float(seconds)

    def set(self, value):
        self.t = float(value)


class RecordingGateway:
    def __init__(self, outcomes=None):
        self.outcomes = list(outcomes or [])
        self.calls = []
        self.charged_refs = set()
        self.charge_count = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))

        if reference in self.charged_refs:
            return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

        outcome = self.outcomes.pop(0) if self.outcomes else "success"

        if outcome == "timeout_charge":
            self.charged_refs.add(reference)
            self.charge_count += 1
            raise GatewayTimeout("unknown outcome after charge")
        if outcome == "timeout_nocharge":
            raise GatewayTimeout("unknown outcome before charge")
        if outcome == "success":
            self.charged_refs.add(reference)
            self.charge_count += 1
            return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

        raise AssertionError(f"input={outcome!r} output='unknown gateway outcome'")

class ManualClock:
    def __init__(self, start=0.0):
        self.t = float(start)

class RecordingGateway:
    def __init__(self, outcomes=None):
        self.outcomes = list(outcomes or [])
        self.calls = []
        self.charged_refs = set()
        self.charge_count = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if reference in self.charged_refs:
            return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}

        outcome = self.outcomes.pop(0) if self.outcomes else "success"
        if outcome == "success":
            self.charged_refs.add(reference)
            self.charge_count += 1
            return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}
        if outcome == "timeout_nocharge":
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout before charge")
        if outcome == "timeout_charge":
            self.charged_refs.add(reference)
            self.charge_count += 1
            raise GatewayTimeout("timeout after charge")
        raise AssertionError(f"input={outcome!r} output='unknown outcome'")

class ManualClock:
    def __init__(self, start=0.0):
        self.t = float(start)

    def now(self):
        return self.t

    def advance(self, seconds):
        self.t += float(seconds)


class RecordingGateway:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.charged_refs = set()
        self.charge_count = 0

    def charge(self, reference, amount_cents):
        self.calls.append((reference, amount_cents))
        if reference not in self.charged_refs:
            self.charged_refs.add(reference)
            self.charge_count += 1
        return {"reference": reference, "amount_cents": amount_cents}
